Name: PDC World Championship Darts
Overview:
Compete against the greatest PDC Champions in the toughest console championship of the year

4 Game Modes: Exhibition, Custom Tournament, Career, and Party Games.

Three difficulty levels/throwing mechanisms: Amateur, Professional, and Master.

The detailed Career Mode is based on the 7 most significant tournaments of the PDC calendar.

Online Multiplayer – compete in friendly and ranked matches.

You can step into the shoes of 16 PDC pros or compete against them, plus commentary from the TV "Voice of Darts" Sid Waddell and top referee Bruce Spendley.

Computer opponents play according to the pros' real average scores and playing styles.

47 Achievements ranging from "163 Bogey-Checkout" to "9 Dart-Finish".
